proof_body:
by
  intro A K _ _ _ _ _ _ x hx
  obtain ⟨a, ⟨b, hb⟩, hab, hx'⟩ := IsFractionRing.exists_reduced_fraction (A := A) x
  have hb0 : b ≠ 0 := nonZeroDivisors.ne_zero hb
  have ha0 : a ≠ 0 := by
    rintro rfl
    apply hx
    rw [← hx']
    simp
  refine ⟨a, b, ha0, hb0, hab, ?_⟩
  rw [← hx']
  exact IsFractionRing.mk'_eq_div ⟨b, hb⟩
target_source: ∀ (A K : Type*) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [UniqueFactorizationMonoid A] [Field K] [Algebra A K] [IsFractionRing A K] (x : K), x ≠ 0 → ∃ a b : A, a ≠ 0 ∧ b ≠ 0 ∧ IsRelPrime a b ∧ x = algebraMap A K a / algebraMap A K b
